result.title: Unified Law for Visual Tasks (The Four Laws of Computer Vision)
result.comment: Preview version (main paper only); This work began in December 2024. Project page at https://world-snapshot.github.io/WSMs; GitHub org at https://github.com/World-Snapshot; Hugging Face org at https://huggingface.co/World-Snapshot; This is an empirical article that attempts to unify thousands of visual tasks through a single methodology. Patent pending (inventors: SF and DM)
result.summary: In this paper, we propose a Unified Law for Visual Tasks, which could be further divided into Four Laws of Computer Vision, with the goal of enabling a single framework or method to uniformly train on and perform nearly all visual tasks. Our starting point is an inspiration and hypothesis: if the world information is encoded into image, which we call World Snapshots, then image processing is world processing, and image generation is World Snapshot generation. Furthermore, if all visual and visualization tasks can be reformulated as generation tasks, then a unified method, World Snapshot Models (WSMs), can perform the vast majority of visual tasks, much as large language models have largely unified natural language processing. This paper validates these laws across more than 1,000 trained and evaluated visual tasks (defined by distinct input-output mappings) and presents a unified training framework for future visual-task research and applications.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出「世界快照」假说与计算机视觉四定律，主张把几乎所有视觉任务统一改写为生成任务，用单一 World Snapshot Models 框架训练与评测，并在千余个视觉任务上做验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是面向视觉任务统一建模的生成式框架性工作，未涉及 VLM 推理中的 latent 状态、证据获取、停止决策或监督分配，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体接口。
